procedural_matters: POR 56465 was represented by Leonor Correia De Sá (crew).
TUR 57052 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
POR 56465 failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3(b)(1). However, there was a good reason for the International Jury to extend the time limit.
Afonso Prieto, coach of POR 56465, attended the hearing as an observer.
Graca Empis, helm of POR 56465, attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident in race 11 of the 420 U17 Silver fleet were 13 knots of wind and choppy sea.
TUR 57052 rounded mark 3P of the outerloop gate.
POR 56465 was sailing astern of TUR 57052 at a distance of one and a half boat lengths
TUR 57052´s entire hull on the prot side made contact with the mark as she was rounding the mark.
TUR 57052 did not take a penalty.
conclusions: TUR 57052 touched mark 3P and broke RRS 31.
